follow-up time: Through the first oocyte retrieval and fresh embryo transfer cycle
cohort: Patients undergoing their first oocyte retrieval with planned fresh embryo transfer
finding: Patients with a BMI > 40 had a comparable pregnancy rate but higher miscarriage rate, lower live birth rate, higher cancelled fresh transfer rate, and higher c-section rate compared to normal-weight patients.
mod_finding: Among singleton deliveries, there was a significant trend of an increased c-section rate as BMI increased.
